generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Prepare source material, dependencies, templates, data, workspace, toolchain, and pre-build readiness checks.

contract.purpose_user_function: Prepare workspace, dependencies, source/templates/data, and toolchain before build execution.
contract.valid_inputs: Execution envelope, repo/worktree path, dependency manifests, template/data refs, toolchain/runtime requirements, and readiness checks.
contract.expected_outputs: Prepared isolated workspace/toolchain with readiness report or explicit blocked status.
contract.state_side_effects: May create worktree/sandbox, install dependencies, copy templates, and generate environment files within authorized scope.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing dependency/tool/runtime/source, install failure, dirty/conflicting workspace, policy denial, or failed readiness check blocks build.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Installer/worktree utilities exist; preparation is task-specific and must avoid real HOME during tests.
contract.success_evidence: Isolated workspace and declared toolchain are ready, manifests unchanged unless authorized, and readiness checks are recorded.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: workspace create; dependency present/missing; install success/failure; template/data; dirty/conflict; readiness.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §Basic Workflow and Appendix AutoSci Commands; docs/WORKFLOW_DESIGN.md Phases 2-5; AGENTS.md Scope and Local Workflow
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Solar ships primarily as a Claude Code overlay. Concrete builds depend on selected physical operators, language toolchains, credentials, datasets, hardware, and approval/write-scope policy.

implementation.interfaces: Builder work is dispatched through harness/lib/operator_runtime.py and physical operators; task-specific interfaces include .agents/skills/exp-run/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-draft/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/paper-compile/SKILL.md, skills/test/SKILL.md
